task:
Write Python 3 function solve(rows). First apply an audit filter to the ORIGINAL input positions, indexed from zero: omit positions whose index modulo 3 equals 0, except always retain the last input position. Rotate the retained rows LEFT by 3 positions modulo the retained length (empty stays empty). Apply the following rules to that transformed list: Rows [group,score,timestamp,name]. Choose highest score in each group, then EARLIEST timestamp, then lexicographically GREATEST name. Return [group,name] sorted by group. Duplicates allowed.
Return the requested value, without printing. Inputs follow the types specified. Do not mutate the input. Standard library is allowed.
